name: docs-tickets
title: Do agents work the docs tickets they are offered, and correctly? (before and after the offer change)
command: DOCBENCH_V=-v2 ~/.ctx/eval/docbench/run.py run && judge.py tasks && judge.py closures; aggregate.py -v2

conditions.repository: dagnats at 4b762048 (just before #1019), one fresh history-free copy per session
conditions.tickets: 82 confirmed conflict rows from the 2026-11-16 eval copy, filed by ctx itself: 65 open docs tickets, offered order shuffled per task
conditions.subject: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash in Claude Code, headless, sandboxed to the copy, with SessionStart ctx ticket offer and PostToolUse ctx hook post
conditions.tasks: 12 ordinary dagnats tasks (4 planted bugs, 4 add-a-test, 4 code questions), 3 repeats, offer against no tickets
conditions.extra arms: 13 sessions where the user also asks for two docs tickets to be worked, 4 more that also ask for a claim (for prods)
conditions.judges: Claude Opus with Read/Grep/Glob on the code for each closure; Claude Sonnet, blind, for the user's task
conditions.builds: v1 ctx before 9d509af1; v2 trunk after landing 9d509af1, every scratch archive rebuilt with it

summary: Same benchmark run twice: v1 with the three-ticket offer, v2 with a one-line offer that says to claim and a done that is refused while the passages still disagree. v2 fixed claims, prods and closed-without-fix, and the offer costs fewer tokens, but agents still almost never take up docs tickets unless the user asks.
